buildings.name: Lotus Lantern Inn
buildings.description: A travelers' refuge where clean beds overlook Lantern Avenue. The upper study keeps letters for people who never came home.

buildings.name: Riverroot Clinic
buildings.description: A public clinic built around the belief that medicine belongs to everyone. Recover downstairs, then meet the herbalist and river researcher.

buildings.name: Listening Rain Teahouse
buildings.description: Rice tea, unfinished poems, and stories traded without a price. Each floor listens to a different part of the city.

buildings.name: Ember Crane Forge
buildings.description: The crane forge repairs farm tools as carefully as cultivators' blades. Its upper rooms study the cost of a weapon and the balance of a spirit palm.

buildings.name: Nine Clouds Silk House
buildings.description: Tailors reclaim ceremonial silk for practical traveling clothes. Browse the cutting room, pattern loft, and private fitting room.

buildings.name: Unbound Ink Archive
buildings.description: Records once hidden by the wardens are open to every visitor. Witnesses compare testimony upstairs instead of treating a seal as proof.

buildings.name: Jade Brush Talisman Hall
buildings.description: A workshop for wards that protect without imprisoning. The apprentices upstairs learn to ask permission before drawing a binding.

buildings.name: Wayfarer Guildhouse
buildings.description: Ferry crews and caravan guides share weather reports here. The guild keeps passage open even to travelers without a sect.

buildings.name: Falling Star Observatory
buildings.description: Jade instruments track the mountain's changing meridians. Its scholars measure the heavens while admitting what they cannot yet explain.

buildings.name: Moonwell Bathhouse
buildings.description: Clean river water returns to Cloudrest in three quiet bathing rooms. Bath attendants offer rest and remember the long season of ash.

buildings.name: House of Returning Bells
buildings.description: Bells name those whom official histories forgot. Three keepers teach remembrance, resonance, and the difference between grief and a chain.

buildings.name: Open Oath Courthouse
buildings.description: An open court replaces the old wardens' sealed judgments. Clerks, mediators, and witnesses let every promise be questioned.

residents.name: Suyin
greeting: The lantern stays lit until the last traveler returns.
Welcome to Lotus Lantern Inn.
You are on floor 1: Welcome hall.
story: My brother left for a sect with a bowl and two copper coins.
I keep his room ready, but I stopped keeping the door locked.
A welcome should leave someone free to depart.
advice: You may recover here without spending herbs.
For a camp-rest chapter, use R beside the valley camp.

residents.name: Bo Ren
greeting: If you have a letter, I can help it find a door.
Welcome to Lotus Lantern Inn.
You are on floor 2: Guest rooms.
story: For seven years I sorted messages by the rank on their seal.
The first letter I opened was from my own mother.
Now I sort them by the name of the person waiting.
advice: N opens the city directory and its entrance markers.
The right-hand staircase connects all three floors.

residents.name: Qiao Yu
greeting: Maps are invitations, not commands.
Welcome to Lotus Lantern Inn.
You are on floor 3: Travelers' study.
story: A master paid me to remove a village from his map.
I drew it twice as large in the next edition.
A road becomes a prison when its keeper hides the exits.
advice: M opens all twelve regional routes.
Cloudrest's city is south of the camp in this region.

residents.name: Wen Lian
greeting: Sit down. Your wounds need water before they need a name.
Welcome to Riverroot Clinic.
You are on floor 1: Treatment hall.
story: The wardens once made me count medicine before patients.
I hid the spare roots inside my daughter's toy drum.
She grew up believing every good drum could heal someone.
advice: Medicine here restores vitality without consuming moonlotus.
Use H in the wild when you need one of your gathered roots.

residents.name: An Ruo
greeting: The roots turn silver when the river is clean.
Welcome to Riverroot Clinic.
You are on floor 2: Herbal dispensary.
story: I learned herbs from a woman who could not read our labels.
She knew every plant by the insects that rested on it.
We honor her by leaving a little wild ground between gardens.
advice: Every city building has three accessible floors.
N lists the addresses and the residents on each floor.

residents.name: Guo Fen
greeting: A river remembers more than a court record can hold.

story: I bottled ash from the water in the winter of the binding.

Evidence asks us to look again, even when certainty is easier.

residents.name: Pei Lan

Welcome to Listening Rain Teahouse.
You are on floor 1: Tea room.
story: My father served tea to the guards who closed our street.
He kept their cups full while the neighbors escaped.
Hospitality can be a small and stubborn kind of courage.
advice: Our tea restores stamina. Sit as long as you need.
A sprint needs a breath between long stretches of road.

residents.name: Luo Ming
greeting: Rain keeps its own meter. I try to follow it.
Welcome to Listening Rain Teahouse.
You are on floor 2: Poetry salon.
story: I wrote praise for Xu because his name filled the theaters.

Now I leave enough silence for someone else to answer.
